name: GST Tax Invoice-wise
query:
SELECT
    x.invoice AS `Invoice:Data:180`,
    x.posting_date AS `Posting Date:Date:100`,
    x.bill_no AS `Supplier or Invoice No:Data:140`,
    x.party AS `Supplier or Customer:Data:180`,
    x.party_gstin AS `Party GSTIN:Data:150`,
    IF(x.is_return = 1, 'Return', 'Invoice') AS `Type:Data:80`,
    IF(x.is_rcm = 1, 'Yes', 'No') AS `Reverse Charge:Data:80`,
    CONCAT(x.gst_rate + 0E0, '%%') AS `GST Rate:Data:80`,
    SUM(x.taxable_value) AS `Taxable Value:Currency:140`,
    SUM(x.cgst_amount) AS `CGST:Currency:120`,
    SUM(x.sgst_amount) AS `SGST:Currency:120`,
    SUM(x.igst_amount) AS `IGST:Currency:120`,
    SUM(x.cess_amount) AS `Cess:Currency:100`,
    SUM(x.cgst_amount + x.sgst_amount + x.igst_amount + x.cess_amount) AS `Total Tax:Currency:130`
FROM (
    SELECT
        pi.name AS invoice, pi.posting_date, pi.bill_no AS bill_no,
        pi.supplier AS party, pi.supplier_gstin AS party_gstin,
        IFNULL(pi.is_return, 0) AS is_return, IFNULL(pi.is_reverse_charge, 0) AS is_rcm,
        ROUND(IFNULL(pii.cgst_rate, 0) + IFNULL(pii.sgst_rate, 0) + IFNULL(pii.igst_rate, 0), 2) AS gst_rate,
        IFNULL(pii.igst_rate, 0) AS igst_rate,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.taxable_value, 0)), IFNULL(pii.taxable_value, 0)) AS taxable_value,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.cgst_amount, 0)), IFNULL(pii.cgst_amount, 0)) AS cgst_amount,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.sgst_amount, 0)), IFNULL(pii.sgst_amount, 0)) AS sgst_amount,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.igst_amount, 0)), IFNULL(pii.igst_amount, 0)) AS igst_amount,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.cess_amount, 0) + IFNULL(pii.cess_non_advol_amount, 0)), IFNULL(pii.cess_amount, 0) + IFNULL(pii.cess_non_advol_amount, 0)) AS cess_amount
    FROM `tabPurchase Invoice Item` pii
    INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Invoice` pi ON pi.name = pii.parent
    WHERE %(tax_type)s = 'Input (Purchase)'
        AND pi.docstatus = 1
        AND pi.company = %(company)s
        AND pi.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
        AND (%(reverse_charge)s = 'All' OR IFNULL(pi.is_reverse_charge, 0) = IF(%(reverse_charge)s = 'Yes', 1, 0))
        AND (%(returns)s = 'Net Off (Include)' OR IFNULL(pi.is_return, 0) = IF(%(returns)s = 'Only Returns', 1, 0))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        pi.name AS invoice, pi.posting_date, pi.name AS bill_no,
        pi.customer AS party, pi.billing_address_gstin AS party_gstin,
        IFNULL(pi.is_return, 0) AS is_return, IFNULL(pi.is_reverse_charge, 0) AS is_rcm,
        ROUND(IFNULL(pii.cgst_rate, 0) + IFNULL(pii.sgst_rate, 0) + IFNULL(pii.igst_rate, 0), 2) AS gst_rate,
        IFNULL(pii.igst_rate, 0) AS igst_rate,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.taxable_value, 0)), IFNULL(pii.taxable_value, 0)) AS taxable_value,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.cgst_amount, 0)), IFNULL(pii.cgst_amount, 0)) AS cgst_amount,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.sgst_amount, 0)), IFNULL(pii.sgst_amount, 0)) AS sgst_amount,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.igst_amount, 0)), IFNULL(pii.igst_amount, 0)) AS igst_amount,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.cess_amount, 0) + IFNULL(pii.cess_non_advol_amount, 0)), IFNULL(pii.cess_amount, 0) + IFNULL(pii.cess_non_advol_amount, 0)) AS cess_amount
    FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` pii
    INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice` pi ON pi.name = pii.parent
    WHERE %(tax_type)s = 'Output (Sales)'
        AND pi.docstatus = 1
        AND pi.company = %(company)s
        AND pi.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
        AND (%(reverse_charge)s = 'All' OR IFNULL(pi.is_reverse_charge, 0) = IF(%(reverse_charge)s = 'Yes', 1, 0))
        AND (%(returns)s = 'Net Off (Include)' OR IFNULL(pi.is_return, 0) = IF(%(returns)s = 'Only Returns', 1, 0))
) x
WHERE (%(gst_rate)s = 'All' OR x.gst_rate = %(gst_rate)s)
GROUP BY x.invoice, x.posting_date, x.bill_no, x.party, x.party_gstin, x.is_return, x.is_rcm, x.gst_rate
ORDER BY x.posting_date, x.invoice, x.gst_rate

name: GST Tax Rate-wise
query:
SELECT
    CONCAT(x.gst_rate + 0E0, '%%') AS `GST Rate:Data:90`,
    CONCAT(x.gst_rate / 2 + 0E0, '%%') AS `CGST or SGST Rate (each):Data:120`,
    CONCAT(x.gst_rate + 0E0, '%%') AS `IGST Rate:Data:90`,
    SUM(IF(x.igst_rate = 0, x.taxable_value, 0)) AS `Taxable Value (Intra-state):Currency:170`,
    SUM(IF(x.igst_rate <> 0, x.taxable_value, 0)) AS `Taxable Value (Inter-state):Currency:170`,
    SUM(x.taxable_value) AS `Total Taxable Value:Currency:160`,
    SUM(x.cgst_amount) AS `CGST:Currency:140`,
    SUM(x.sgst_amount) AS `SGST:Currency:140`,
    SUM(x.igst_amount) AS `IGST:Currency:140`,
    SUM(x.cess_amount) AS `Cess:Currency:110`,
    SUM(x.cgst_amount + x.sgst_amount + x.igst_amount + x.cess_amount) AS `Total Tax:Currency:150`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT x.invoice) AS `Invoices:Int:80`
FROM (
    SELECT
        pi.name AS invoice, pi.posting_date, pi.bill_no AS bill_no,
        pi.supplier AS party, pi.supplier_gstin AS party_gstin,

        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.cess_amount, 0) + IFNULL(pii.cess_non_advol_amount, 0)), IFNULL(pii.cess_amount, 0) + IFNULL(pii.cess_non_advol_amount, 0)) AS cess_amount
    FROM `tabPurchase Invoice Item` pii
    INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Invoice` pi ON pi.name = pii.parent
    WHERE %(tax_type)s = 'Input (Purchase)'
        AND pi.docstatus = 1
        AND pi.company = %(company)s

        pi.customer AS party, pi.billing_address_gstin AS party_gstin,
        IFNULL(pi.is_return, 0) AS is_return, IFNULL(pi.is_reverse_charge, 0) AS is_rcm,
        ROUND(IFNULL(pii.cgst_rate, 0) + IFNULL(pii.sgst_rate, 0) + IFNULL(pii.igst_rate, 0), 2) AS gst_rate,
        IFNULL(pii.igst_rate, 0) AS igst_rate,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.taxable_value, 0)), IFNULL(pii.taxable_value, 0)) AS taxable_value,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.cgst_amount, 0)), IFNULL(pii.cgst_amount, 0)) AS cgst_amount,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.sgst_amount, 0)), IFNULL(pii.sgst_amount, 0)) AS sgst_amount,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.igst_amount, 0)), IFNULL(pii.igst_amount, 0)) AS igst_amount,
        IF(pi.is_return = 1, -ABS(IFNULL(pii.cess_amount, 0) + IFNULL(pii.cess_non_advol_amount, 0)), IFNULL(pii.cess_amount, 0) + IFNULL(pii.cess_non_advol_amount, 0)) AS cess_amount
    FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` pii
    INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice` pi ON pi.name = pii.parent
